title: Frequently Asked Questions | House of Zen
description: Answers from House of Zen in Detroit: what we carry, first-time help, hours, ID, the first customer offer, the live menu and Michigan cannabis basics.
lede: Everything you need to know, explained clearly and simply.

items.a_html: We offer flower, pre-rolls, edibles, concentrates, topicals, CBD products, and glass accessories.
Absolutely. We specialize in guiding first-time customers with clear education and recommendations.

items.q: All products are licensed and tested?
items.a_html: Yes. All products are fully licensed, lab-tested, and compliant with state regulations.

items.q: How do I choose the right product?
items.a_html: Our team will help you based on your comfort level, preferences, and desired experience.

items.q: What are your hours, and where are you?
items.a_html: We are open Mon-Sun: 9 am to 9 pm, at 14501 Mack Ave, Detroit, MI 48215. Our Detroit dispensary page has the details, and you can call us at (313) 332-1733.

items.q: How old do I need to be, and what ID do I bring?
items.a_html: You need to be 21 or older, and Michigan requires a licensed adult-use store to check a valid driver’s license or government-issued photo ID before any sale. If you hold a medical card, please call us to confirm whether and how we can serve medical card holders today.

items.q: Is there an offer for first-time customers?
items.a_html: Yes: first customer deals: 30% OFF the purchase. Promotional offers may be subject to additional terms, and our Deals page explains where to read them.
Yes. Our live menu lists products by category, and it is the place to check current specials. You can also read about each category under Products.

Using marijuana in a public place is not allowed in Michigan, and property owners may ban smoking or use on their property. Michigan Cannabis Laws has more, including areas a municipality may designate for consumption.
A licensed adult-use store may sell no more than 2.5 ounces in a single transaction, with no more than 15 grams of it as concentrate. Adults 21 and older may carry up to that same amount.

items.q: Why does the price change at checkout?
items.a_html: Michigan adds a 10% excise tax and a 6% sales tax to adult-use purchases, and the sales tax is figured on the price including the excise. On a $100 sale, that comes to $10 of excise tax and $6.60 of sales tax.

Start with a small amount, give it plenty of time, and only then decide whether you want more. Everyone responds differently, so there is no hurry, and our Dispensary Guide and Edibles: Start Low, Wait Long are good places to begin.

blocks.html: Michigan details are as of October 2026. General information, not legal advice.
